entries.reason: The affected duplicate-attribute parsing path is not reachable from agent- or user-controlled XML in ShellX's dependency owners.
evidence: quick-xml 0.30.0 is an xcb build dependency that parses crate-packaged XCB protocol XML.
tauri-winrt-notification 0.7.2 uses quick-xml 0.37.5 only for XML escaping and does not instantiate a Reader.
quick-xml 0.39.4 is used by build-time Wayland protocol generation and Tauri plist handling for project or current-bundle Info.plist data; ShellX exposes no arbitrary plist parser surface.
entries.upgradeCondition: Remove as soon as xcb, notify-rust/tauri-winrt-notification, wayland-scanner, and plist accept quick-xml 0.41 or later.

entries.reason: None of ShellX's quick-xml dependency owners use the affected NsReader namespace API.
evidence: Source inspection of xcb 1.7.0, tauri-winrt-notification 0.7.2, plist 1.9.0, and wayland-scanner 0.31.10 found no NsReader use.
The 0.30.0 and Wayland parser inputs are dependency-owned build inputs, while the Windows notification owner uses only quick_xml::escape::escape.
entries.upgradeCondition: Remove as soon as all dependency owners accept quick-xml 0.41 or later.

entries.reason: The affected rkyv archive-validation code is not compiled into ShellX because rkyv is an inactive optional dependency of rust_decimal.
evidence: rust_decimal 1.42.0 declares rkyv 0.7.46 as optional and activates it only through its rkyv or rkyv-safe features; ShellX enables neither feature.
For the current Cargo.lock, cargo tree --target all -i rkyv@0.7.46 returns no active dependency path, while rust_decimal is reached only through byte-unit 5.2.0 and tauri-plugin-log 2.8.0.
ShellX has no direct rkyv dependency and does not call rkyv archive access or deserialization APIs.
entries.upgradeCondition: Remove when rust_decimal upgrades its optional rkyv integration to 0.8.17 or later, or when the inactive rkyv 0.7 series leaves the resolved lockfile.

entries.reason: The affected VariantStrIter iterator API is not called by ShellX or its reviewed Linux UI integration paths.
evidence: glib 0.18.5 is a Linux-only transitive dependency of Tauri's GTK3, WebKitGTK, and menu stack; ShellX has no direct glib dependency.
A tracked-source search finds no VariantStrIter reference in ShellX or its vendored Vault crates.
The advisory is limited to VariantStrIter next, next_back, nth, nth_back, and last; ShellX does not expose a Variant string iterator surface.
entries.upgradeCondition: Remove when Tauri's Linux stack reaches glib 0.20 or later, or immediately if a reviewed dependency path begins using VariantStrIter.
